rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for the physical firmness of a material or object.

example.english: The solidity of this piece of wood is good enough for a tabletop.
example.traditional: 呢塊木嘅硬度夠，做枱面啱晒。
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 muk6 ge3 ngaang6 dou6 gau3 zou6 toi2 min6 ngaam1 saai3

rows.note: Use this for the soundness, validity, or trustworthiness of an argument, claim, or position.

example.english: The solidity of this argument is hard to challenge.
example.traditional: 呢個論點嘅可靠性好高，幾乎冇人可以反駁。
example.jyutping: ne1 go3 leon6 dim2 ge3 ho2 kaau3 sing3 hou2 gou1 gei1 fu4 mou5 jan4 ho2 ji5 faan2 bok3

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on certainty or definiteness rather than on whether something is sound or trustworthy.

example.english: This report fails to establish the solidity of the conclusion.
example.traditional: 呢份報告未能證明結論嘅確定性。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 mei6 nang4 zing3 ming4 git3 leon6 ge3 kok3 ding6 sing3
